TermsPage.metaTitle: Terms & Conditions | Zain's Treat n More
TermsPage.metaDescription: Read the terms and conditions for ordering from and using the Zain's Treat n More website.
TermsPage.heading: Terms & Conditions
TermsPage.orderingCopy: By placing an order with Zain's Treat n More, you confirm that the details you provide are accurate and that you are authorized to place the order.
TermsPage.paymentCopy: Payment terms and accepted payment methods will be confirmed at the time of order or booking.
TermsPage.cancellationCopy: Cancellation requests should be made as early as possible. Cancellation terms may vary depending on the order type and how close it is to the delivery or event date.
TermsPage.refundsCopy: Refund eligibility depends on the circumstances of the order and will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.
TermsPage.deliveryCopy: Delivery and pickup options, timing, and any associated fees will be confirmed when an order is placed.
TermsPage.cateringCopy: Catering orders may require advance notice, a minimum order size, and a deposit depending on the scale of the event.
TermsPage.eventBookingsCopy: Catering rental bookings are subject to availability and should be confirmed in advance of the event date.
TermsPage.customerResponsibilitiesCopy: Customers are responsible for providing accurate order, delivery, and contact information, including any allergy or dietary requirements.
TermsPage.websiteUsageCopy: This website should be used only for lawful purposes related to browsing, ordering, and enquiring about our food and services.
TermsPage.changesCopy: Zain's Treat n More may update menu items, services, and prices at any time without prior notice.

PrivacyPage.metaTitle: Privacy Policy | Zain's Treat n More
PrivacyPage.metaDescription: How Zain's Treat n More collects, uses and protects your personal data, how long we keep it, and your rights under the GDPR.
PrivacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This policy explains what personal data we collect when you use this website, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and what your rights are. We only collect what we need to handle your order, booking or question.
PrivacyPage.whoCopy: Zain's Treat n More is responsible for your personal data (the “controller” under the GDPR). We're a small food business based in the Netherlands.
PrivacyPage.whoContact: Questions or requests: email <email>contact@zainstreat.com</email> or message us on <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp>.
PrivacyPage.collectIntro: We only receive the details you type into our forms, plus a few technical details every website needs:
PrivacyPage.collectOrders: Food orders: your name, email, phone number, delivery address (for delivery) and any notes, plus what you ordered and the amounts.
PrivacyPage.collectEvents: Event bookings: your name, email, phone number, party size, each guest's meal choice and any notes.
PrivacyPage.collectCatering: Catering enquiries: your name, email, phone number, event details (type, date, guests, location) and your message, plus the quote we send you.
PrivacyPage.collectContact: Contact form: your name, email, phone number, subject and message.
PrivacyPage.collectTechnical: Technical data: our servers log your IP address, the pages you request and your browser type, to keep the site working and secure.
PrivacyPage.whyContract: To take, prepare, deliver and confirm your order or booking, send your invoice and status updates, and answer questions about it. This is needed to carry out our agreement with you (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)).
PrivacyPage.whyQuote: To answer a catering enquiry and prepare a quote, at your request, before any agreement (Article 6(1)(b)).
PrivacyPage.whyLegal: To keep our bookkeeping, as Dutch tax law requires (Article 6(1)(c)).
PrivacyPage.whyInterest: To answer contact messages and keep the website secure. This is our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f)).
PrivacyPage.whyNot: We don't use your data for marketing, we don't sell it, and we don't make automated decisions or profiles about you.
PrivacyPage.sharingIntro: Only with the service providers that run the website for us, under data processing agreements:
PrivacyPage.sharingHosting: Amazon Web Services (AWS), in Frankfurt, Germany: hosting, backups and sending our emails.
PrivacyPage.sharingMail: Our email provider, which receives the emails you send to contact@zainstreat.com.
PrivacyPage.sharingPush: Apple, Google or Mozilla push services, which deliver order notifications to the owner's own phone. These contain your name.
PrivacyPage.sharingDelivery: PDOK (the Dutch government's address service) and Mapbox: when you choose delivery, PDOK receives the address you type so you can pick it, and Mapbox receives only its map coordinates to work out the driving distance for the delivery fee.
PrivacyPage.sharingWhatsapp: If you message us on WhatsApp, WhatsApp (Meta) handles that conversation under its own privacy policy.
PrivacyPage.sharingTransfers: Where a provider may process data outside the European Economic Area, it does so under the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
PrivacyPage.retentionBookkeeping: Orders, paid event bookings and accepted catering quotes: 7 years, because Dutch tax law requires it. After that, your name and contact details are removed and only the amounts stay.
PrivacyPage.retentionShort: Cancelled unpaid orders, free event RSVPs, waitlist entries, catering enquiries that didn't lead to an order, and contact messages: 12 months.
PrivacyPage.retentionEmail: Our log of sent emails: 90 days.
PrivacyPage.retentionLogs: Server logs: overwritten automatically, usually within a few days.
PrivacyPage.retentionBackups: Backups: deleted after 30 days. If we restore a backup, we remove any data you asked us to erase again.
PrivacyPage.cookiesCopy: We don't use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. We only store what the site needs to work:
PrivacyPage.cookiesLocale: A NEXT_LOCALE cookie that remembers your chosen language.
PrivacyPage.cookiesCart: Your cart, saved in your own browser (local storage) until you order or empty it.
PrivacyPage.cookiesOrder: Your last order confirmation, saved in your browser until you close the tab.
PrivacyPage.cookiesConsent: Because these are strictly necessary, Dutch law doesn't require your consent for them.
PrivacyPage.rightsCopy: You can ask us to see the data we hold about you, correct it, delete it, limit how we use it, object to how we use it, or get a copy in a common file format to take elsewhere.
PrivacyPage.rightsHow: Email <email>contact@zainstreat.com</email> from the address you used with us. We answer within one month. Data we must keep for tax reasons is anonymised instead of deleted.
PrivacyPage.complaintCopy: If you're unhappy with how we handle your data, please tell us first. You can also complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, the <ap>Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens</ap>, or to the authority in the country where you live.
PrivacyPage.securityCopy: The site uses HTTPS throughout. Only the owner can see your details, through a password-protected admin. If a data breach ever puts you at risk, we'll tell you and the authority as the law requires.
PrivacyPage.changesCopy: If we change how we use your data, we'll update this page and the date at the top.
